name: FORM — container (machine select)
convention: key 0 = AUX; keys 1-10 = black keys / F1(1) F2(2) + machine slots; keys 11-26 = white keys (16-step row). Colors are '#RRGGBB', '#000000' = off. These states show the FORM CONTAINER: the top-row machine picker and the SELECTMACHINE type picker. The lower 16 keys are painted by whichever machine is selected (see form_omni.json / form_euclid.json).
notes: FORM hosts up to 8 pluggable sequencer 'machines' in the 8 top-row slots (keys 3-10). Each slot's LED shows its machine TYPE color: empty=off, OMNI=orange (#ff8000), EUCL=cyan (#00ffff). The SELECTED slot is WHITE (or SALMON #ff8080 if muted); a MUTED slot is RED. When a machine fires a step it flashes INDIGO (#4b0082) on its slot key. Keys 0/1/2 = AUX / F1 / F2 (function keys, unlit in base). The bottom 16 keys belong to the selected machine. Interaction: tap slot = select; double-tap slot = mute; HOLD slot = enter the type picker (state 3); F1(hold key1)=copy machine, F2(hold key2)=cut/paste, F1+F2=F3 machine shortcut.

states.name: Base — machine select (stopped)
states.notes: Resting FORM view, transport stopped. Top row: slot0(key3)=selected OMNI=WHITE, slot1(key4)=OMNI=ORANGE, slot2(key5)=EUCL=CYAN, slot3(key6)=EUCL=CYAN, slot4(key7)=empty=off, slot5(key8)=OMNI muted=RED, slots6-7=empty. Bottom row shows the selected OMNI machine's step pattern (LTBLUE #a8a8ff = step has notes, DKBLUE #00004d = step in-length but empty).

keyNotes.0: AUX — hold for shortcut layer (octave, play/reset)
keyNotes.1: F1 — hold to copy a machine
keyNotes.2: F2 — hold to cut/paste a machine
keyNotes.3: Selected machine slot (WHITE). Tap=select, double-tap=mute, hold=type picker

encoder.note: Turn = select parameter; AUX+turn = edit value

states.name: Base — playing (playhead + trigger flash)
states.notes: Transport running. The selected OMNI machine fired a note THIS step, so its slot key3 flashes INDIGO (#4b0082, overrides the WHITE selected color for one step). On the step row the playhead sits on step 5 (key15), which has notes, so it shows WHITE. If the playhead landed on an empty/muted step it would show RED instead. Other slots keep their type colors.

keyNotes.3: Selected machine flashing INDIGO because it triggered this step
keyNotes.15: Playhead (WHITE = step fired). RED here would mean the playhead is on a silent step

encoder.note: Turn = select parameter; AUX+turn = edit value

states.name: Select machine (type picker)
states.notes: Reached by HOLDING a top-row slot key (here slot0/key3, still WHITE). The lower keys become a machine-TYPE menu: key11=NONE (off, blinks DKRED #800000 when it is the current type), key12=OMNI (ORANGE), key13=EUCL (CYAN). The current type's key blinks; here the slot is OMNI so key12 pulses ORANGE<->off. Press 11/12/13 to set the type; release the held slot key to return to base. Top row still shows the other slots.

keyNotes.3: Held slot being retyped (still shown WHITE = selected)
keyNotes.11: Set type = NONE (empty). Blinks DKRED when NONE is current
keyNotes.12: Set type = OMNI (ORANGE) — current type, blinking
